scripts.test:emulator: pnpm --filter @kampusagi/functions build && node scripts/emulators-exec.mjs auth,firestore,storage,functions "pnpm --filter @kampusagi/functions test:emulator && pnpm --filter @kampusagi/web test:emulator"
scripts.dev:local: pnpm --filter @kampusagi/functions build && node scripts/emulators-exec.mjs auth,firestore,storage,functions "node scripts/seed-emulator.mjs && pnpm --filter @kampusagi/web dev"
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @kampusagi/functions build && pnpm build:web:emulator && node scripts/emulators-exec.mjs auth,firestore,storage,functions "pnpm --filter @kampusagi/web test:e2e"
